title: Self-assembly of tetra nuclear lanthanide (Pr, Nd) hydroxo clusters with functionalized β-diketone: Experimental and theoretical studies

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: tetranuclear praseodymium hydroxo cluster with o-hydroxydibenzoylmethane

synthesis.procedure: HO-DBM and PrCl3·6H2O were added to 30 mL of methanol and stirred at ambient temperature for 10 min to give a clear solution. Triethylamine was added dropwise; a pale yellow precipitate formed midway through base addition. Stirring was continued for 12 h at room temperature. The precipitate was collected by filtration, washed with 5 mL of methanol to remove residual triethylamine hydrochloride, and dried in air. X-ray quality pale yellow block crystals were obtained in 1–3 weeks from dichloromethane/hexane.
synthesis.time: 10 min then 12 h stirring; crystals in 1–3 weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: ligand-controlled hydrolysis in methanol; filtration; recrystallization from CH2Cl2/hexane
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Precipitate filtered, washed with 5 mL methanol, dried in air. Pale yellow block crystals grown from dichloromethane/hexane over 1–3 weeks.
